title: Free [CLIENTSIDED] Balloon Giver!
features:
This script, made by me, will give you a single Green Balloon in the game Natural Disaster Survival! 

⚠️ Please note that you will not be able to receive a Green Balloon if a player with a Green Balloon is not already present in the server. 

✅ Get a Green Balloon! 
✅ Built-In notification system to notify you if there are no balloons found in the server!

comments.text: It works! (and also im not a robot i just act like one)
